title: SSR: Pre-render Song List on Home Page
description: Server-side render the song list on the home page for better SEO and initial load performance. Only names and thumbnails needed.

technicalContext.approach: Use TanStack Start's server functions to fetch songs at request time
technicalContext.data: Song titles, thumbnails, language flags - minimal data for list view
technicalContext.seo: Songs should be crawlable by search engines

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create server loader function to fetch songs from Convex
Home page uses loader data for initial render (not client-side fetch)
Song list renders with: title, thumbnail, language
View page source shows song titles in HTML (not just loading state)
Page loads with content visible before JS hydration
Convex real-time updates still work after hydration
MOBILE-FIRST: Song cards responsive on all screen sizes
